snippet.title: Winter X Games SnoCross - Official Trailer | Experience Extreme Snowmobile Racing!
snippet.description:
Welcome to the official trailer for Winter X Games SnoCross™! Immerse yourself in the adrenaline-pumping action of the Winter X Games with this thrilling snowmobile racing game. Featuring a stunning 42″ LCD panel for HD graphics and a motion seat that puts you right in the middle of the action, SnoCross™ offers an unparalleled gaming experience.

Race with 6 unique snowmobile racers and 6 killer sleds, each with insane custom upgrades. Travel across 7 intense tracks in iconic locations including France, Antarctica, China, Alaska, Washington D.C., Moscow, and Colorado. Perform the same sick tricks you see in the X Games, with huge airtime giving you more opportunities to wow the crowd. Engage in fierce battles by throwing snowballs at your opponents and aim for the top spot on the leaderboard.

With an ultra-high marquee and a brightly colored cabinet, SnoCross™ draws players from across the room. Link up to 8 cabinets to create a competitive atmosphere and challenge your friends. Share your scores to Facebook with personalized QR codes and show off your skills!

Don't miss out on the ultimate snowmobile racing experience – be part of the Winter X Games with SnoCross™!
